claims.claim_text: 實例裡一個 part 把 6.02 GB 壓成 537.9 MB（約九成），裝下 4,240,299 列、分成 1,915 個 block，並用 bloom filter 加速字詞查找。就算在 IOPS 很低的 HDD 上，也能每秒灌進約 1 GiB 日誌。
claims.evidence: "CompressedSizeBytes": 537919490, "UncompressedSizeBytes": 6024698288; "RowsCount": 4240299, "BlocksCount": 1915; bloom filter asked first; absorbs ~1 GiB/s even on slow low-IOPS HDDs

claims.claim_text: rseq 讓 user space 註冊一段臨界區：若執行到一半被搶佔或遷移到別的 CPU，核心會跳到 abort handler 重做，而不是上鎖。TCMalloc 這類 allocator 是主要受益者。Cosmopolitan 也正在實作 rseq 支援。
claims.evidence: gslin: 既然無法避免 preemption…就讓 user-space 偵測到，跑 abort 並重新執行; kernel makes extensive use of per-CPU data structures to avoid locking; TCMalloc rseq writeup; author is Cosmopolitan lead, plans to implement

claims.claim_text: Elevator 做 x86-64 到 AArch64 的全靜態整段 binary 翻譯；翻出來的 .text 在 SPECint 2006 上比原生編譯的 AArch64 大 47.5 到 62.5 倍，但效能可與 QEMU 模擬競爭、甚至更快。
claims.evidence: "Elevator's translated .text is 47.5x to 62.5x larger than natively-compiled AArch64 .text across SPECint 2006"; faster than QEMU emulation

claims.claim_text: WAN 往返會吃掉 co-located speculative decoding 原本 1.5 到 3 倍的加速；分散式做法的價值在多租戶吞吐，能多撐約 (1 + γ·t_d/t_v) 倍的並行客戶端。
claims.evidence: "DSD's per-request latency benefit is limited under WAN edge-cloud communication"; "co-located SD has lower latency and communication than synchronous DSD"; "(1 + γ·t_d/t_v) times more concurrent clients at the same per-client rate"

claims.claim_text: Intel Core Ultra 7 268V 加總 2^26 整數散在 65,536 分頁：循序 1.327 億 cycle，隨機 15.7 億 cycle（~12 倍）；8-page stride 最壞 20.6 億 cycle，比純隨機又慢約三成。
claims.evidence: linear 132752394 cycles, randomized 1572108618 cycles (~12x); 8-page stride 2058425640 cycles (~30% worse than random); Intel Core Ultra 7 268V; 2^26 across 65,536 pages

claims.claim_text: 中位數約省 5 到 15ms（5%），p90 省 48ms（13%）、p95 省 146ms（21%），亞洲 p95 直接少 200ms；真正受惠約一成使用者，那一成正是延遲最高的人。
claims.evidence: p50 -5.55ms/-4.15%; p90 -47.6ms/-12.5%; p95 -146ms/-20.9%; Asia ~77ms p90, 200ms p95; "HTTP3 noticeably reduces latencies for only 10% of our users, these will be the users who suffer from high latencies"

claims.claim_text: LY Corporation 把原 LINE 與原 Yahoo Japan、合計超過 1 EB 的 HDFS 叢集用 DistCP 接起來；LINE 用 client-side ViewFS，Yahoo Japan 用 server-side RBF 加 Observer NameNode；最棘手是兩套權限模型；跨叢集靠 Kerberos cross-realm。
claims.evidence: "exceeds a total capacity of 1 exabyte (EB) when combining…former LINE…and former Yahoo Japan"; LINE ViewFS client-side; Yahoo Japan Router-based Federation + Observer NameNodes; DB/Table-level vs HDFS Path-level permissions; Kerberos Cross-Realm

claims.claim_text: 2021 年程式錯誤短暫把內部移除理由洩漏給一般使用者；可看到 Spamurai（2020 起、Lua 規則）、Google Perspective API、Spammit 垃圾百分比；帳號特徵含帳齡、karma、ISP、email 網域、user-agent、TLS 指紋；自動封網域從 2012 就在跑。
claims.evidence: 2021 bug: usual 'Removed: Auto' replaced with actual removal reason; Spamurai Lua rules; Perspective free Google service to reduce toxicity; 'Removed: spammit(72.98% spammy)'; account age/karma/ISP/email/user-agent/TLS fingerprint; automatic domain banning since 2012

claims.claim_text: Collider 1.3.0 修掉兩個供應鏈漏洞：路徑穿越（releases.json 名字逃出快取目錄）與 token 外洩（bearer token 跟跨來源轉址被重送）；作者主張靠 origin pinning 與簽章補上。
claims.evidence: "Collider 1.3.0 fixed two places where untrusted input reached past that line"; '../../../../etc/cron.d/x' escapes cache dir; 302 redirect to another host receives the token; 'A verified hash…does not prove who produced them'; 'Signing is the next item on the roadmap'

claims.claim_text: NanoEuler 用純 C/CUDA 從零實作 GPT-2 規模模型——約 1.16 億參數、16 層、手寫 forward 與 backward、自刻 FlashAttention kernel、單張 RTX 4070；無 PyTorch、無 autograd，每個解析梯度拿中央差分驗證。
claims.evidence: "A GPT-2-class language model built entirely from scratch in C/CUDA — no PyTorch, no autograd"; 16 layers, ~116M params; hand-written forward/backward + hand-written FlashAttention; single RTX 4070; every analytic gradient compared against a central finite difference
